Project Summary: Lunar Landing Site Navigator

Our project, Lunar Landing Site Navigator, aims to help identify suitable and safe landing locations on the Moon. It provides a way to compare different lunar landing sites and dates quickly by visualizing the positions of the Sun and Earth relative to the lunar horizon. The system helps assess the potential for solar power generation and identifies suitable communication windows between the Moon and Earth. This project is important because choosing the right landing location is essential for successful lunar missions. It can help astronauts and space researchers make better decisions, improve mission planning, and support reliable communication and energy availability during lunar exploration. Our goal is to develop a useful and easy-to-understand navigation tool that supports future Moon missions.
